items.summary: Create a FloatingWhatsApp component as a fixed circular button in the bottom-right corner of the page. The button must use WhatsApp green (#25D366) background with a white WhatsApp SVG icon inside. On click, it opens a new tab to 'https://wa.me/919819187188?text=Hello%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20know%20more%20about%20your%20Ayurvedic%20face%20packs.' The button should be 56×56px on desktop and 48×48px on mobile, positioned at bottom-right with enough margin to avoid overlapping footer or important content.

Add a soft box-shadow to the FloatingWhatsApp button and a smooth hover animation: on hover, the button scales up slightly (e.g., scale-110) and gains a subtle green glow effect. A tooltip with the text 'Chat with us on WhatsApp' should appear above the button on hover, styled in earthy/natural tones consistent with the Ayurvedic palette.

Add an entrance animation to the FloatingWhatsApp button so it fades in and slides up from the bottom when the page first loads. Use a CSS keyframe or Tailwind animation (e.g., fade-in + translate-y) with a short delay (300–500ms) so it does not distract from initial page content.

Mount the FloatingWhatsApp component inside the CustomerLayout wrapper in App.tsx so it appears on all customer-facing pages. The component should read the WhatsApp number from the backend site settings (via the existing useWhatsAppNumber or site settings React Query hook) and only render when a valid number is configured. Use the hardcoded number '919819187188' as the fallback default if the backend returns an empty string.
